lines.en: : I swear to fucking god, if she doesn’t show up...
: Uhh...I’m no expert at shrines and stuff, but I’m pretty sure this is the last place you should be swearing to God.
: And I’m pretty sure I’m going to set Ami’s half of the dorm on fire if she made both of us come all the way out here for nothing.
: Maya, come on! I’m sure there’s a perfectly reasonable explanation for this! Maybe she’s just running late? Or her...phone died or something!
: Ami would never just flat-out ditch us, would she?
: We have been here...for a fucking hour, Ayane. How much longer do we need to wait before you realize something is wrong?
: How long am I supposed to wait?! Because the last time you had an issue with my...waiting tendencies, it was specifically because I started freaking out!
: Now, you’re telling me I’m supposed to be freaking out after telling me I’m not allowed to on the roof?! What do you want from me?!
: What I want is for you to shut up. The phone is ringing.
: I never know what to say around you anymore...
: Then you’re better off not saying anything.
It sings in its sleep.
From its hole in the wall, a shadow emerges.
Unconscious and covered in ash, its eyes remain closed as its body marches onward, disconnected from the orb that’s meant to move it.
It has one goal — to find another hole and lay itself down in a brand new resting place.
It doesn’t have to be a special one.
All that matters is that it remains hidden.
Damp, dank, and several other D-adjectives combine forces to form a form of force that will form a fourth form, forced outforth before the fourth can form its course.
Cicadas, spiders, birds, and any other creature you have assigned some level of significance to all conjoin as well into one ultimate being to end all other beings.
If God or god exists, I think It or it needs to be everything.
I don’t think we’re allowed to choose one or the other. In fact, I think the others as a whole are not so whole at all.
Think back to the holy trinity and question why it was ever deemed a trinity in the first place since the cross has four points, not three.
Could they not form fourth for some added posterity in that grand fairy-tale of theirs?
Because while you may be taught that the middle part is one-
And while you may be taught that the top is king-
And while you may be taught to ignore the bottom-
You’re smart enough to count to the things you see before you.
And you know you’re being lied to.
But who’s the one that’s lying now that none of that really matters?
Is it Ami? Your lovable niece?
Maya? Your former lover?
Ayane? The deeply unfortunate third wheel that wasn’t replaced at the same time the others were?
Is EVERYONE lying to you?
Is there anyone you can trust at all?
I think there is.
But telling you WHO would be against the rules.
So I’ll sit and watch, my eyes are glued — just this time with a better view;
I’ll hold your hand and sleep with you — just not the way you want me to.
It’s not that I don’t care, I do — this is different and you know it’s true.
And if you don’t, pick up my clues — they’re everywhere and dressed in blue!

: Come the fuck on! Where are you?!
: What, now you don’t have anything to say all of a sudden?
: Huh? No, I just...thought I...
: Wait, why are you taking your anger out on me?! I’m not the one who ditched you! I walked here with you!
: I don’t have anyone else to take it out on! And we probably wouldn’t even be in this mess if it weren’t for you!
: How is any of this my fault?! I was just trying to watch a movie when you barged in and started yelling stuff about Ami!
: I don’t know! But it’s definitely not mine! And...
: And you probably said something about the resets to her even though I told you not to.
: Did you, Ayane?
: Did you tell her something?
: I guess...maybe?
: I might have made, like...a joke or something. But it’s not like I’ve actually tried talking to her about it...
: I know you and me don’t always see eye to eye about this stuff but I still take everything you say seriously.
: Hah...
: Have you tried calling Sensei instead? He-
: It’s going straight to voicemail. His phone is probably dead. Ami’s is still ringing, though.
: What does...what would me talking to her about all that time stuff even do, though? Why would she stop hanging out with us over that?
: It’s a long story.
: Then fucking tell me, Maya! What good does it do to be so fucking cryptic about everything?!
: I’m not like this because I want to be! I’m like this because I’ve learned time and fucking time again that not being careful about the things I say can cause everything to spiral out of control!
: I’m sure it must be fan-fucking-tastic living in an infinite school-year and not having to deal with countless memories of personally destroying everything, but I can’t do that!
: Okay. Yeah. I get that. And I’m not trying to make light of what you’ve been through. I just don’t understand what any of this has to do with Ami.
: Why is she bailing on us? Why is she inviting us to the shrine in the first place? Why does she apparently get mad whenever she learns about the timeloops?
: How can she learn about them if she’s supposed to interrupt us whenever they’re brought up? There are a million things I don’t know because you’re keeping everything to yourself.
: And I get that you’re, like, not good at talking about stuff or whatever, but you’ve never tried talking to me. And I’m not Sensei. I can probably, like, understand your problems to some extent.
: Why? Because you can relate to me?
: Why are you saying that like it’s a bad thing?
: Probably because you’ve been fucking flaunting how “relatable” you are this entire fucking time!
: What?...
: Do you have any idea how fucking infuriating it is hearing about all of the shit you get to do with Sensei when I can’t even fucking touch him?!
: Do you think it’s funny?! Do you think I like that?! Because I fucking hate it, Ayane! I hate it, I hate it, I hate it, I hate it!

: Maya...I didn’t...
: I didn’t really...uhh...
: I guess I...didn’t really understand what you were...
: Yeah. Because I’m fucking cryptic or whatever. But, like I said, I’m not like that because I want to be. I just don’t know what I can and can’t do and...
: And I feel like certain aspects of this world might make you even more afraid of it than you already are.
: What?
: You heard me. Don’t make me say it again.
: Do you mean you were...do you mean it was never a trust thing at all? You just didn’t want to make things more...complicated than they already were? For my sake?
: My wording was better.
: Hah...
: You’d think after a bajillion school years there would have been at least one Ayane that made you realize I can take a punch or two.
: This is more than just a punch, Ayane.
: This is bad.
: Ami getting too involved in this isn’t something as trivial as just risking our friendship or...tightening Sensei’s leash.
: It is dangerous.
: As in...she could somehow put...the reset at risk? Has she gotten in the way before or something?
: Hah...
: Yes.
: But it’s far more complicated than just that.
: Can you tell me how? Or are you just going to be all cryptic again?
: I’m going to do my best to not be emotional...and deliver this message in a way more like my normal self.
: As long as it’s delivered...
: If it’s this important, I need to know.
: Then...
: Please listen closely.
: Because while I don’t understand the reason why the resets seem to trigger her-
: I’ve seen what happens when they do.
: I have watched you...the others...and even Sensei suffer at her broken hands because she will stop at nothing to protect her world.
: What...do you mean by-
: I mean that the only thing preventing her from becoming violent is the illusion that she lives the perfect life.
: That her uncle does not just love her, but is in love with her.
: That her friends understand and acknowledge her feelings...and always act in her best interests.
: And that nothing or no one gets in the way.
: And if...someone does?
: She’ll get rid of them.
: She’ll...what?
: Before all of the transfers...
: There was not a single girl in our class...
: That I had not seen butchered...
: Or bound...
: Or beaten...
: Or broken...
: Abused...
: Humiliated...
: Tortured...
: Maimed...
: Poisoned...
: Sodomized...
: Starved...
: You can’t be...no. No way. This is Ami we’re talking about. Like, yeah! She’s obsessed with Sensei on an...abnormal and dangerous level...but she’d never do anything like that to us!
: We’re her friends! We’re-
: We’re nothing to her.
: We’re just part of the illusion.
: She’ll play into it...and treat us well if we treat her well...
: But the Ami I'm talking about will never see us as anything more than disposable sacks of flesh.
: Then...then all those things you say about her being cute! And how you love her! All of that’s been fake?! This entire time?!
: Maya!
: Hahah...that's the hilarious part...
: None of it’s been fake at all...
: I do love her.
: I do think she’s the cutest girl I know.
: But how can I not when she’s always been right there?
: How can I let the bad memories taint the brighter ones when they’ve only come as the result of things I have done wrong?!
: The real Ami isn’t like that! The real Ami wouldn’t hurt us! Only the one we create would!
: Which is exactly why she can never know where we are...or when we are.
: Because that’s what changes her. That’s what plants the seed...
: And everything that comes after just helps it grow...
I love my niece.
She’s the greatest niece in the whole wide world.
Sometimes, when I fall asleep, her face reappears inside of my dreams.
When I look in the mirror, I see her behind me- even when she isn’t there.
In every gust of wind, I hear her name.
In every song, I hear the same.
Every time I encounter the color red, I compare it to the hue of her eyes.
I’ve memorized them.
It was easy.
They’re the same as her mother’s.
: Sensei...
: Yeah?...
: Tell me you love me again.
: I love you...
: Only me?
: Only you...
: You promise?
: I promise...
: Can I sleep in your bed tonight?
: Of course...
: And tomorrow? And the day after?
: You can do whatever you want...
: You promise?
: I promise...
: Sensei...
: Yeah?...
: Tell me you love me again.
I love my niece.
But sometimes I worry that I don’t love her enough.
